description: This file defines the AcknowledgementAggregatorActorStarter class, which manages the startup process of acknowledgement aggregator actors within an Akka actor system. It handles configuration, header translation, and initiation of actors for processing acknowledgement signals, including validation and conditional starting based on signal properties.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregatorActorStarter
classes.description: A utility class responsible for initiating and managing acknowledgement aggregator actors within an Akka actor system, based on signals and configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AcknowledgementAggregatorActorStarter with specified context, configuration, header translator, and optional ack request setters.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an acknowledgement aggregator actor for a given signal if conditions are met, executing callback functions based on success or failure.

methods.name: preprocess
methods.description: Preprocesses a signal to determine if an acknowledgement aggregator actor should be started, validating headers and conditionally initiating actors.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Actually initiates the acknowledgment aggregator actor and applies provided response consumer and success callback.

methods.name: startAckAggregatorActor
methods.description: Creates and starts the actor with appropriate properties and naming convention.

methods.name: getNextActorName
methods.description: Generates a unique actor name based on signal's correlation ID.

methods.name: buildAckRequestSetter
methods.description: Builds a partial function to set acknowledgment requests in signals based on provided setters.

methods.name: getDittoHeaderInvalidException
methods.description: Validates headers in a signal and returns an exception if headers are invalid.

methods.name: shouldStartForIncoming
methods.description: Determines whether to start acknowledgment processing based on the signal type and acknowledgment requests.
